question_format: 01+010+r(3bits)+0+(a,b,c,d each 5bits+0)+111100 = 39 raw bits; r1 answer word(a)+S
unique_factor: only c value 0 vs 2 (one bit) per fixed checkpoint and fixed a,b,d; model arm R20 vs R23 is frozen prior teaching factor; no new model or other intervention
calibration: a=0..3,b=20..23,d=3,c=0/2 => 32 Q; calibration MUST NOT be used to adjust gate or test inputs
test: a=4..7,b=18..23,d=3,c=0/2 => 48 Q; heldout a disjoint from calibration; include previously unseen a6,7; same Q previously untested
gate_interpretation: Per seed: mean teacher-position STOP logit margin (S minus max(0,1)) for c2 improves >=1.0 over R20, c0-c2 gap closes >=0.5, c0 STOP accuracy loss <=2 of 24; require >=2/3. Not dependent on non-ceiling accuracy; also report exact and first-word correctness. One-word r1 only.
blindness: All test and calibration raw Q frozen BEFORE any R24 checkpoint forward; researcher knows historical lexical vocabulary and R21-23 so not completely blind

provenance.U: user independent small native01 NN learning program
provenance.F: R20/R23 fixed checkpoint + code; PR5 and P030-P035 other lines, not copied
provenance.A: c2-curriculum may improve invariance in d3 / novel a; confidence low

limits: No new training; fixed checkpoint transfer not causal re-training; teacher-forced STOP margin is diagnostic and full native01 generation separately scored; no SLE vs ordinary binary conclusion.
